episode_summary: The hosts discuss China's booming one-minute micro-dramas and their AI-driven future, celebrate the 105-year-old inventor behind chattering teeth and other classic toys, and explore how paracetamol works despite its still-mysterious mechanism. They finish with Ghanaian fufu—how it’s prepared, and a wider tour of yams, cassava, and related cultural traditions.

facts.fact: My fact is, half of China watches TV dramas that are one minute long.
My fact this week is that the inventor of the chattering teeth and croplunk, as well as 800 other joke toys, is still inventing new products at age 105.
My fact this week is that nobody knows why parasitimal works.
Okay, my fact this week is that in order to prepare the National Dish of Ghana, you need to vigorously pound your fufu for at least 20 minutes.
